shots.description: Fixed wide view from behind one player on an indoor badminton court with blue playing surface and green borders. The foreground player is seen mostly from the back in a black short-sleeved shirt with pink graphics, light gray shorts, white socks, and dark shoes, holding a racket in his right hand; across the net, another male player in a dark top and dark shorts faces him. They rally continuously: shuttlecock travels over the net, both players move laterally and step into shots, and by about 2 to 4 seconds the far-side player jumps for overhead returns while the near-side player stays lower and reacts from midcourt.

A cut changes to a fixed rear view of a different pairing on the same court. In the foreground stands a curly-haired man in a navy sleeveless vest over a white T-shirt, black shorts, orange socks, and dark shoes, watching rather than actively rallying. Across the net, a younger-looking boy in a maroon or red-toned top and dark pants performs repeated practice strokes while moving side to side under feeders' tosses from off-screen left and/or right. He crouches, steps, lifts the racket, and at least once rises into a jumping overhead action before landing and resetting.

tail.description: Near the end, the second shot remains visible: the vested adult stands upright in the foreground facing the net, while the child continues active movement on the far side of the court after hitting successive fed shuttles. No further scene change is observed within the clip.
readable_text: XURI STAR 专业羽毛球学院

conclusions: Correct content-part sibling fps=10 changes native video token usage from 4754 to 23762, approximately 5x; the legacy nested video_url.fps produces the same 4754 as the default.
Native fps=10 omitted the final shot in the broad task but described it when explicitly asked about the final 0.5 s; omission is not proof that the server supplied no tail frames.

Local frames plus video read the final subtitle in both tasks. This path includes explicitly timestamped pictures and guaranteed source-shot endpoint frames, so it is not identical to a bare native fps setting.
The local path uses 49945 total input tokens versus native fps10 24190 for the broad task; this comparison includes image/text overhead and different modality preprocessing, not just frame rate.
These are single diagnostic trials per task/mode, not a statistically controlled accuracy benchmark. Different output event counts are not accuracy scores.

The tests use non-thinking mode, identical prompts within each task, and the same model/video/output limit. The production pipeline has different stage prompts and uses thinking mode for visual review.
